content.comment_body: I have a PC application and want to control outputs directly via WLAN connection. Is there a way to do this without using the integrated web server? Are there any tutorials or resources for this?
If you would like to switch outputs on or off directly on the [product_name], these outputs in the [product_name] program should not be connected to any logic on the input side.

Hello, if you want to operate outputs of a [product_name] [version_no] without the [product_name] program, here are your options: 1. The [product_name] needs to be set to RUN mode. 2. Any output that is not in use or not linked on the left side in the [product_name] program can be controlled. 3. Your software must support Modbus TCP or S7 communication for output control. 4. Some forum members have built alternative solutions with other software—search the forum for details. Hope this information is useful.
